title: Public garages.
officialText:
Appliances located in public garages, motor fueling-dispensing facilities, repair garages or other areas
frequented by motor vehicles, shall be installed a minimum of 8 feet (2438 mm) above the floor. Where motor vehicles are capable of
passing under an appliance, the appliance shall be installed at the clearances required by the appliance manufacturer and not less than
1 foot (305 mm) higher than the tallest vehicle garage door opening.
Exception: The requirements of this section shall not apply where the appliances are protected from motor vehicle impact and
installed in accordance with Section 304.3 of this code and NFPA 30A.
